values: 魔法学校自创始以来的才女，擅长通过吟唱来释放五花八门的魔法。
The most brilliant female student in the school's history, she weaves a colorful tapestry of spells through chanting.
I'll get rid of them in one shot.
I don't want to die like this!
交给我吧！我来把它们全轰掉！
Leave this to me. I'll wipe them out!
It really is important to try things first.
Was it like a yell? Or more like a roar?
玛露西尔是一名优等生，但她在迷宫中所使用的许多魔法都是临时学会的。
Marcille is a model student, though many spells she uses in the dungeon are learned on the fly.
玛露西尔不太擅长运动，偶尔会在赶路时拖小队后腿。
Marcille is not very athletic, and sometimes slows the team down when traveling.
玛露西尔喜欢看恋爱小说，对于别人的恋情八卦也很感兴趣。
Marcille loves romance novels, and always perks up for relationship gossip.
玛露西尔经常改变发型，因为她深知毛发对施法至关重要，整理头发也是她进行魔法准备的一环。
Marcille often changes up her hairstyle because hair is magically important. Fixing her hair is part of her magical routine.
虽然玛露西尔会使用治疗魔法，但因为生效速度快，伤者有可能会受到“治愈痛”的折磨。
Marcille can also use healing magic, but due to its rapid effect, those who are healed may suffer from "recovering pain".
法琳是玛露西尔的好友，也是因为法琳的牵线，玛露西尔才加入了莱欧斯的冒险小队。
Falin is Marcille's friend and the reason she joined Laios' adventurer party.
玛露西尔坚决不吃亚人系魔物，尽管她曾在不知情的情况下吃过鱼人的卵。
Marcille refuses to eat demihuman monsters, though she once unknowingly ate fish-man's eggs.
安布罗希亚是玛露西尔亲手编织的法杖。当玛露西尔的魔力严重不足时，法杖顶端的叶子也会蔫掉。
Marcille made her staff, Ambrosia, by hand. When her magic runs low, the leaf at the tip wilts.
玛露西尔在迷宫中曾被石化，伙伴们在努力解除她石化的同时，她还被拿去做腌菜石使用。
Marcille was once turned to stone in the dungeon. While her party members were trying to restore her, someone used her as a pickling stone.
虽然玛露西尔和法琳都曾在魔法学校学习，但她们的魔法体系不同——玛露西尔主要研究古代魔法，而法琳则专攻地精系魔法。
Marcille and Falin both studied at the magic school, but they practiced different kinds of magic—Marcille focused on ancient spells, and Falin specialized in goblin magic.
